name: webex-ai-validator
description: Reviews Webex AI Agent instructions for the selected engine and channel, reports built-in guardrail impacts, identifies risks, and designs use-case validation tests.

interface.longDescription: Reviews the user's Webex AI Agent instructions for the selected Webex AI Pro engine and Voice or Digital channel, recommends improvements and edits, reports impacts from the included obfuscated built-in guardrails, identifies likely hallucination and other concern areas, and proposes use-case-specific tests with expected results. It reviews Webex AI Pro 1 for ChatGPT 4.1 and Webex AI Pro 2 for ChatGPT 5.4. The guardrail encoding is reversible obfuscation, not encryption. It does not execute tests or certify runtime behavior.
capabilities: Review Voice or Digital channel-specific behavior
defaultPrompt: Review my Webex AI Agent instruction set for the selected Webex AI Pro engine and Voice or Digital channel. Report built-in guardrail impacts, improvements, risks, and use-case validation tests.
